hook: I loved you. I just didn’t like your face that day.
obstacle: Two depleted people amplify one another because the room gives them no distance.
proof: Their simultaneous pull slides the extension board, tips the intact lamp and darkens the room.
bridge: Automatic care precedes conflict; equal repair begins before either mood softens.
relationship_motion: Both care, obstruct, escalate and repair.
payoff: The wide reprise keeps the mess visible while ordinary shared rhythm continues.
send_save_reason: One bad day is evidence about the day, not the whole relationship.
